description: `ui-health validate scenario <name>` reports a finding whenever a file's JSDoc provenance block disagrees with the authoritative SQLite adoption row (drift_hash mismatch or missing-on-either-side).

requirements.description: The `ui-health validate scenario <name>` command must compare each adopted file's JSDoc provenance block against the authoritative SQLite adoption row in `react-component-library`. A Finding of type PROVENANCE_DRIFT must be emitted whenever: (a) the drift_hash in the JSDoc block does not match the SQLite row, (b) a JSDoc block exists on a file with no corresponding SQLite adoption row, or (c) a SQLite adoption row exists for a file that has no JSDoc block.
requirements.title: JSDoc vs SQLite Provenance Drift Detection in Validation

validation.notes: Mismatched drift_hash between JSDoc and SQLite row produces a PROVENANCE_DRIFT Finding
File with JSDoc provenance block but no SQLite row produces a PROVENANCE_DRIFT Finding
File with SQLite row but no JSDoc provenance block produces a PROVENANCE_DRIFT Finding
File where JSDoc and SQLite agree produces no PROVENANCE_DRIFT Finding
Modify the drift_hash in a JSDoc block of an adopted file without updating SQLite, run validation, and confirm PROVENANCE_DRIFT Finding is emitted
Delete the JSDoc block from an adopted file while keeping the SQLite row, run validation, and confirm PROVENANCE_DRIFT Finding is emitted
Confirm that clean scenarios with synchronized JSDoc and SQLite produce zero PROVENANCE_DRIFT Findings
Drift check for a scenario with 200 adopted files completes within 3 seconds
Developers are alerted when adopted component metadata goes out of sync between the SQLite store and source file annotations

title: Drift detection between SQLite and JSDoc
